What is included?

All 20 inventoried source artifacts were reviewed as text or extracted graphic text. This release integrates their substantive themes; it does not reproduce every sentence, deck, image or confidential record. Detailed credentials are sanitized, older graphics are archival, and annual data reconciliation remains incomplete.

Source identifiers correspond to the repository’s project-work register. Each chapter is a public synthesis rather than a claim that source assertions have all been independently verified.
